item.title: Maintaining an Open-Source Library With AI Agents: AGENTS.md and the Rule They Kept Breaking
item.description: On May 9th I merged #264. It added an AGENTS.md to go-proxmox and a stub CLAUDE.md that just points at it. The next six weeks ran through the v0.8.0 migration guide on June 15th. In that time main took 77 commits and +31,794 / -1,144 lines. The repo went from 84 to 186 .go files. Endpoint coverage went from 30% to 100% of the Proxmox API. Most of that code was typed by coding agents, a lot of it by several at once. This is what that looked like from the maintainer’s chair. It’s mostly the parts that went wrong, because that’s where AGENTS.md got its content.
